news.headline: Borregales went without a field-goal try for the first time in a regular-season contest since Week 10 of the 2025 campai
news.detail: Borregales went without a field-goal try for the first time in a regular-season contest since Week 10 of the 2025 campaign. The kicker made the three kicks that he was given the opportunity to attempt Sunday, and he figures to get more field-goal chances in Week 5 against the Raiders.
